summary: One VivaCity-style camera (counter 320) covering 7 zones at Pacific Hwy / Marks Point Rd, Marks Point, 2024-03-25 to 2025-05-28; the June-August 2024 outage and short zone dropouts are already set missing by the automatic zero_outage fixes, and the remaining low days (e.g. 2024-04-05, 2024-09-26, 2025-04-27, 2025-05-22) are camera-wide and look like weather. The main issue is an abrupt, zone-uneven 3-4x step up on 2024-11-08 that also rebalances IN and OUT, pointing to a detection/configuration change, so each direction is split into a series before and after that date and the earlier period is flagged uncertain.
